get_system_status.title: Check Browse AI system status
get_system_status.description: Report the operational status of the Browse AI infrastructure. Returns tasksQueueStatus, either OK or UNDER_MAINTENANCE; check it before launching many tasks or a bulk run, and use list_robots instead to confirm the API key itself works.

list_teams.title: List teams
list_teams.description: List the teams the authenticated Browse AI user belongs to. Returns totalCount and items, each with the team id, name, whether API access is enabled, and createdAt as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

items.description: Team records with id, name, api and createdAt.

list_robots.title: List robots
list_robots.description: List every robot (website scraper or monitor configuration) in the account. Returns totalCount and items with each robot's id, name, createdAt and its declared inputParameters. Use get_robot for a single robot when you already have its ID.

items.description: Robot records with id, name, createdAt and inputParameters.

get_robot.title: Get a robot
get_robot.description: Retrieve one robot by ID. Returns its id, name, createdAt and inputParameters — the list of input parameter names, types and defaults you can override when calling run_robot, create_monitor or bulk_run_robot.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

inputParameters.description: Declared input parameters with name, type, label and default value.

update_robot_cookies.title: Update a robot's cookies
update_robot_cookies.description: Replace or add the cookies a robot sends when it loads the target site, for example to keep a logged-in session alive. Returns the robot's resulting cookies. Each cookie needs at least a name and value.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

cookies.description: Cookies to set. Each item: name (required), value (required), domain (e.g. '.example.com'), path (e.g. '/products/'), expirationDate (seconds since the UNIX epoch; omit for a session cookie), secure, httpOnly, hostOnly (booleans).

domain.description: Domain the cookie is sent to.

path.description: URL path the cookie is sent to.

expirationDate.description: Expiry in seconds since the UNIX epoch.

hostOnly.description: Only send to the exact domain.

output.description: The robot's cookies after the update.

list_robot_tasks.title: List a robot's tasks
list_robot_tasks.description: List the tasks (individual runs) of a robot, ten per page at most, optionally filtered by status, bulk run and creation date. Returns result.robotTasks with totalCount, pageNumber, hasMore and items including captured data. Use get_task for one task's full details.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

page.description: Page number of results to return, starting at 1.

robot_bulk_run_id.description: Only tasks that belong to this bulk run ID.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields to sort by, ascending by default; prefix a field with '-' for descending, e.g. '-createdAt,finishedAt'.

include_retried.description: Pass false to exclude tasks that were retried.

from_date.description: Only tasks created at or after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

to_date.description: Only tasks created at or before this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

run_robot.title: Run a robot
run_robot.description: Run a robot once, on demand, optionally overriding its input parameters. Returns the new task, usually with status in-progress; poll get_task with its id (or register a webhook with create_webhook) to get the captured data when it finishes. For many inputs at once use bulk_run_robot. Each run consumes account credits.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

input_parameters.description: Input parameters overriding the robot's defaults, keyed by the names the robot declares (see get_robot's inputParameters), e.g. {"originUrl": "https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb", "companies_limit": 10}. Values are strings, numbers or arrays of strings.

record_video.description: Try to record a video of the run. Not guaranteed: the robot may skip recording if the site is too heavy.

capturedLists.description: Captured lists by name, each an array of row objects.

capturedScreenshots.description: Captured screenshots by name, with their URLs.

userFriendlyError.description: Why the task failed, when it did.

get_task.title: Get a task
get_task.description: Retrieve one task of a robot with its status and captured data — capturedTexts, capturedLists, capturedScreenshots, a temporary captured-data URL, timings, any error and video URL. Use it to poll a task started by run_robot until status is successful or failed.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

task_id.description: Unique task ID, as returned by run_robot or list_robot_tasks.

output.description: The task and its captured data.

capturedLists.description: Captured lists by name, each an array of row objects.

capturedScreenshots.description: Captured screenshots by name, with their URLs.

userFriendlyError.description: Why the task failed, when it did.

list_monitors.title: List a robot's monitors
list_monitors.description: List the monitors on a robot — scheduled recurring runs that watch a page for changes. Returns totalCount and items with each monitor's id, name, status, schedule, inputParameters and notification settings. Use get_monitor for one monitor.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

create_monitor.title: Create a monitor
create_monitor.description: Create a monitor on a robot that runs it on a recurring schedule with the given input parameters and emails you when captured text or screenshots change. Returns the new monitor. Use update_monitor to change or pause it later.
create_monitor.notes: The deprecated `schedules` array (FIXED_INTERVAL everyMinutes) is not exposed; use the RRULE `schedule` string.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

input_parameters.description: Input parameters overriding the robot's defaults, keyed by the names the robot declares (see get_robot's inputParameters), e.g. {"originUrl": "https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb", "companies_limit": 10}. Values are strings, numbers or arrays of strings.

schedule.description: Recurrence rule in RRULE form, e.g. 'FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1;BYWEEKDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR'.

notify_on_captured_screenshot_change.description: Email you when a change is detected in captured screenshots.

notify_on_captured_text_change.description: Email you when a change is detected in captured texts.

captured_screenshot_notification_thresho.description: Send the screenshot-changed email only when the change exceeds this percentage, e.g. 15.

inputParameters.description: Input parameters each scheduled run uses.

get_monitor.title: Get a monitor
get_monitor.description: Retrieve one monitor of a robot. Returns its id, name, status (active or paused) and pausedReason, schedule, inputParameters, notification settings and timestamps. Use list_monitors to find monitor IDs.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

monitor_id.description: Unique monitor ID (a UUID), as returned by list_monitors or create_monitor.

inputParameters.description: Input parameters each scheduled run uses.

update_monitor.title: Update a monitor
update_monitor.description: Change a monitor's name, schedule, input parameters or notification settings, or pause and resume it by setting status. Only the fields you pass are changed. Returns the updated monitor; use delete_monitor to remove it entirely.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

monitor_id.description: Unique monitor ID (a UUID), as returned by list_monitors or create_monitor.

status.description: Set to paused to stop the monitor until active is sent again.

input_parameters.description: Input parameters overriding the robot's defaults, keyed by the names the robot declares (see get_robot's inputParameters), e.g. {"originUrl": "https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb", "companies_limit": 10}. Values are strings, numbers or arrays of strings.

schedule.description: New recurrence rule in RRULE form, e.g. 'FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1'.

notify_on_captured_screenshot_change.description: Email you when a change is detected in captured screenshots.

notify_on_captured_text_change.description: Email you when a change is detected in captured texts.

captured_screenshot_notification_thresho.description: Screenshot-change percentage above which the email is sent.

inputParameters.description: Input parameters each scheduled run uses.

delete_monitor.title: Delete a monitor
delete_monitor.description: Permanently delete a monitor from a robot, stopping its scheduled runs. Returns only a success status. To stop it temporarily instead, call update_monitor with status paused.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

monitor_id.description: Unique monitor ID (a UUID), as returned by list_monitors or create_monitor.

output.description: Success status code and message code.

bulk_run_robot.title: Bulk run a robot
bulk_run_robot.description: Start a bulk run that executes a robot once per input-parameter set, up to 50,000 tasks in one call. Returns result.bulkRun with its id; follow progress with get_bulk_run, or list its tasks with list_robot_tasks filtered by robot_bulk_run_id. Consumes credits for every task.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

title.description: A label describing the bulk run (1-200 characters).

input_parameters.description: One input-parameter object per task to run (up to 50,000), each overriding the robot's defaults, e.g. [{"originUrl": "https://a.example"}, {"originUrl": "https://b.example"}].

list_bulk_runs.title: List a robot's bulk runs
list_bulk_runs.description: List the bulk runs started on a robot, a page at a time. Returns totalCount, pageNumber, hasMore and items with each bulk run's id, title, status and task counts. Use get_bulk_run for one bulk run and its tasks.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

page.description: Page number of results to return, starting at 1.

get_bulk_run.title: Get a bulk run
get_bulk_run.description: Retrieve one bulk run of a robot together with a page of the tasks it ran. Returns result.bulkRun (status and counts) and result.robotTasks (paged task records with captured data). Page through tasks with page.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

bulk_run_id.description: Unique bulk run ID, as returned by bulk_run_robot or list_bulk_runs.

page.description: Page number of results to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The bulk run and a page of its tasks.

robotTasks.description: Paged tasks with totalCount, pageNumber, hasMore and items.

list_webhooks.title: List a robot's webhooks
list_webhooks.description: List the webhooks registered on a robot. Returns totalCount and items with each webhook's id, url, webhookEvent and createdAt. Use create_webhook to add one and delete_webhook to remove one.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

create_webhook.title: Create a webhook
create_webhook.description: Register a webhook URL on a robot that Browse AI calls with the task payload when the chosen event happens — the push alternative to polling get_task. Returns the webhook with its id, url, webhookEvent and createdAt.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

hook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the webhook POSTs.

event_type.description: Event that fires the webhook: taskFinished (any finish), taskFinishedSuccessfully, taskFinishedWithError, taskCapturedDataChanged (monitor detected a change) or tableExportFinishedSuccessfully.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook
delete_webhook.description: Permanently remove a webhook from a robot so Browse AI stops calling its URL. Returns only a success status. Find webhook IDs with list_webhooks.

robot_id.description: Unique robot ID (a UUID). Find it with list_robots, or copy it from the robot's URL in the Browse AI dashboard.

webhook_id.description: Unique webhook ID, as returned by list_webhooks or create_webhook.

output.description: Success status code and message code.
